name: bld_mantel_triangle_free
statement: (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (h : G.CliqueFree 3) : 4 * G.edgeFinset.card ≤ Fintype.card V ^ 2
closed: ∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (h : G.CliqueFree 3), 4 * G.edgeFinset.card ≤ Fintype.card V ^ 2
informal: Uses Mathlib2.comb_degree_add_degree_le_of_triangle_free: summing deg u + deg v ≤ |V| over edges gives ∑_v deg(v)^2 ≤ |E| |V|; Cauchy–Schwarz and the handshake lemma give (2|E|)^2 ≤ |V| ∑ deg^2 ≤ |V|^2 |E|. Extends Mathlib2.comb_card_edgeFinset_le_of_coloring_bool from bipartite to triangle-free graphs (Mantel).
type: ∀ (V : Type) [inst : Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [inst_2 : DecidableRel G.Adj], G.CliqueFree 3 → 4 * G.edgeFinset.card ≤ Fintype.card V ^ 2
